Small synthetic product-format templates, not captures of owner activity.
decision.json uses additive window metadata to exercise historical bounds. Current
DecisionRow omits that metadata; the tests also remove it and require insufficient.
G3 fallback and G11 timing pause metadata in the tests are additive explicit facts,
not fields currently emitted by the product. No current absent field is a pass.
idle.json independently supplies a complete scheduler lifecycle to the actual smoke
oracle; test variants alter only duration/identity. Tests frame rows with real v1 seals.
held-posted.jsonl is a four-line, redacted hold/posted regression shaped like local
journal history. No completion observations are needed to prove these deliveries.
Temporary test captures live below this directory and are removed after every test.
